description:
About Merciv
Merciv is building the intelligence layer for enterprise commerce. We connect an organization's entire data landscape — internal systems, social signals, industry reports, consumer behavior — and surface the insights and automated workflows that used to take analysts weeks.


We raised $14M in seed funding, spent two years in stealth building the right thing, and we're now launching publicly. Our platform already drives 8-figure gross margin improvements for some of the world's largest retailers.


We're a lean, high-ownership team. If you want to see your work matter immediately, this is it.

The Role
You'll work across every layer of Merciv's platform — from backend services processing enterprise data at scale to the frontend interfaces that make intelligence accessible and actionable. Full-stack here means full ownership: you take features from idea to production and iterate directly with enterprise clients.


This role is for engineers who are energized by breadth, who want to understand the whole system, and who see product context as a superpower.

What You'll Do

 - Build and ship features end-to-end — backend in Go/Python, frontend in React/TypeScript

 - Design APIs, data models, and service architectures supporting Merciv's agentic AI capabilities

 - Create intuitive interfaces that translate complex enterprise data into clear, actionable workflows

 - Collaborate with ML/AI engineers to bring AI-driven features to production

 - Own the full lifecycle: scoping, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and iteration

 - Work directly with enterprise customer feedback to understand real-world needs and shape the product

 - Contribute to infrastructure, tooling, and developer experience as we scale


You May Be a Good Fit If

 - You have 3+ years of engineering experience with meaningful work across frontend and backend

 - You're proficient in TypeScript/React and at least one of Go or Python

 - You have strong product instincts — you think about the user, not just the code

 - You're comfortable taking a vague problem and turning it into a shipped feature

 - You have experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) and modern deployment practices

 - Former technical founders are encouraged to apply — we care more about what you've built than how long you've been building


Bonus points for:

 - Experience with agentic AI systems, LLM integrations, or RAG architectures

 - Background in enterprise SaaS, retail tech, or data-intensive products

 - Familiarity with data visualization, real-time systems, or streaming architectures

 - Contributions to developer tooling, CI/CD, or infrastructure automation


How We're Different
Most AI platforms bolt intelligence onto existing workflows. We're building the intelligence layer from scratch — connecting every data source an enterprise touches and making it actionable in real time. Our agentic infrastructure doesn't just surface insights; it acts on them. That's a harder problem, and it's the one we're solving.

Why Merciv

 - Our platform drives 8-figure gross margin improvements for the world's largest retailers — you'll see real impact fast

 - Hard technical problems at the intersection of agentic AI, distributed systems, and enterprise data

 - Small team, massive surface area — you own what you build

 - Competitive salary, meaningful equity, benefits, flexible PTO

 - A culture built on craft, intellectual honesty, and real human connection


Interview Process

 1. Application reviewed by a human

 2. Intro call with our recruiting team

 3. Technical conversation with an engineering lead

 4. On-site — meet the team, work through a real problem


We Encourage You to Apply
Strong candidates don't always meet every qualification listed. If you're excited about this problem space and have the engineering fundamentals, we'd rather talk to you than not. We're building a diverse team on purpose — different perspectives make the product and the company better.

Logistics

 - On-site in NYC, 3-5 days/week

 - Visa sponsorship available

 - Applications reviewed on a rolling basis



Merciv is building the future of autonomous commerce. We're committed to assembling a diverse team of builders who want to revolutionize how the world does business.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
